sn35.29:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandaka nivāpe.
sn35.29:1.6: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave, andhabhūtaṃ, rūpā andhabhūtā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ andhabhūtaṃ, cakkhusamphasso andhabhūto. yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi andhabhūtaṃ.
sn35.29:1.8: jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi andhabhūtanti vadāmi. sotaṃ …pe…
sn35.29:1.9: jivhā andhabhūtā, rasā andhabhūtā, jivhāviññāṇaṃ andhabhūtaṃ, jivhāsamphasso andhabhūto. yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi andhabhūtaṃ.
sn35.29:1.11: jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi andhabhūtanti vadāmi.
sn35.29:1.13: mano andhabhūto, dhammā andhabhūtā, mano viññāṇaṃ andhabhūtaṃ, manosamphasso andhabhūto, yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi andhabhūtaṃ.
sn35.29:1.15: jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi addhabhūtanti vadāmi.
sn35.29:1.16: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati …pe… manasmimpi nibbindati, dhammesupi nibbindati, manoviññāṇepi nibbindati, manosamphassepi nibbindati,
sn35.29:1.17: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati.
sn35.29:1.18: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.29:1.19: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
